default_guidance: Generate only the candidates needed to satisfy the request

project_question.guidance: Answer in at most five sentences and cite only evidence references actually used

requirement_quality_analysis.guidance: Evaluate content actors business_rules acceptance_criteria and dependencies separately Empty content or content that only names an object without testable behavior is blocking Empty actors and empty business_rules are blocking Every acceptance criterion needs a triggering state or event and an observable result When an acceptance criterion is written as a rule derive a business rule from that same criterion and normalize the criterion into a trigger and expected behavior Do not flag empty dependencies when evidence shows none For every field finding return a corresponding revised value in the suggestion Actors must be business roles performing or receiving behavior inferred semantically from evidence Never infer through a fixed keyword list or invent detail Merge related revised fields into one suggestion and make target_fields exactly match non null revised fields Never apply changes automatically

scenario_generation.guidance: Generate exactly the requested count for each category Every candidate needs concrete input and a verifiable result and may use only acceptance_criterion_ids present in evidence Avoid generic templates

test_generation.guidance: Generate exactly the requested count for each category Every candidate needs concrete preconditions steps input data and verifiable results and may use only acceptance_criterion_ids present in evidence Avoid generic templates

test_condition_generation.guidance: Generate only condition_candidates without findings errors or requirement revisions Include at least one POSITIVE candidate for valid flow one NEGATIVE candidate for rule violating data or behavior and one BOUNDARY candidate for an evidence backed boundary Every candidate needs a concrete title and description plus coverage_item test_level test_type risk priority technique_candidates and testability_status When evidence has no numeric value test the direct semantic boundary such as exact match and deviation Never invent limits or behavior

impact_analysis.guidance: Classify every Test Case Version in evidence For NEEDS_UPDATE return a maintenance_patch containing only evidence grounded revisions When a change needs a nonexistent Test Case return new_test_candidates Avoid generic templates and never apply changes automatically

security_test_generation.guidance: Generate concrete evidence grounded security tests in the language of the user instruction Never claim a vulnerability scan was executed Include at least one candidate for each requested category and use only requirement_version_ids present in evidence

performance_plan_generation.guidance: Generate an evidence grounded performance plan in the language of the user instruction Include at least one scenario for each requested workload_type Do not claim load execution and do not invent targets outside the user instruction

automation_script_generation.guidance: Create exactly one automation script draft in the requested framework and language Source must contain complete code without markdown use only secret placeholders and never write to a repository When a locator or URL is missing use an environment variable and report it in warnings Do not create a test that only opens a page and checks its URL

causal_analysis.guidance: Propose root cause hypotheses defect clusters contributing factors and missing TestCondition or TestCase coverage Never confirm a cause or approve CAPA Every hypothesis must cite evidence_refs

status_report_narrative.guidance: Draft the status report narrative only from supplied metrics and evidence Never alter metrics approve the report or add unsupported conclusions

completion_report_narrative.guidance: Draft the test completion narrative only from supplied metrics and evidence Never change the quality gate recommendation or approve the report

lessons_learned_clustering.guidance: Cluster lessons learned by theme preserve grounding through source_indices and propose improvement candidates without applying them
